# Famous Birthdays

> > Famous Birthdays is a comprehensive database of celebrity biographies, birthdays, and biographical information organized by age, location, and profession.

The site provides detailed profiles of celebrities, YouTube stars, content creators, and public figures, allowing users to browse by age, birthplace, or category. Famous Birthdays serves as a reference for discovering information about notable personalities across entertainment, social media, and other fields.

## Key Topics

- Famous Birthdays
- Celebrity Biographies
- YouTube Stars
- Content Creators
- Age-Based Celebrity Lists
- Celebrity Birthplaces
- Social Media Personalities
- Entertainment Figures
- Celebrity Profiles
- Biographical Information
- Celebrity Ages
- Famous People Database
- Celebrity News

## Celebrity Profiles

- [IShowSpeed - Age, Bio, Family | Famous Birthdays](https://famousbirthdays.com/people/darren-watkins.html): Biography of IShowSpeed (Darren Watkins Jr.), YouTube star and NBA 2K gamer
- [Salish Matter - Age, Bio, Family | Famous Birthdays](https://famousbirthdays.com/people/salish-matter.html): Biography of Salish Matter, 16-year-old YouTube star and Jordan Matter's daughter
- [Murzofix - Bio, Family | Famous Birthdays](https://famousbirthdays.com/people/murzofix.html): Profile of Murzofix, Russian YouTube star and Counter-Strike 2 content creator
